title: Admin guardrails for IP allowlist, public-share disable, and export controls
creator: Aisha Khan
project: Security Controls: RBAC v2 & Admin Controls
description:
Goal: Implement server-side admin toggles and enforcement for three compliance guardrails: (1) IP allowlisting for account-level access, (2) disable public sharing (prevent 'share link' or public embed creation), and (3) data export controls (block CSV/JSON/Archive exports or require elevated approval). The feature must integrate with RBAC v2 role mapping, SSO/SAML admin attribute, and produce comprehensive audit log events for every state change and enforcement action.

Background: Customers in regulated industries have asked for a single switch in the admin console that prevents accidental data egress and reduces surface area for misconfiguration. We already have preliminary RBAC v2 roles and an audit pipeline; this ticket scopes the end-to-end controls, enforcement, UI affordances, and rollout.

Scope (what this ticket delivers):
- API and server enforcement paths for three toggles at the organization level: ip_allowlist_enabled, public_share_disabled, export_block_mode (enum: off, warn, block).
- Integration with RBAC v2: changes to toggles can only be performed by users with the admin role mapped via SAML attribute or local org admins in Dedicated/Private.
- Audit logging: every toggle flip, attempted export while blocked, and blocked public share must emit structured audit events including actor, timestamp, IP, prior_state, new_state, and request_id. Events must surface to Console and to exportable audit streams (SIEM/Kafka).
- SSO/SAML: document required attribute mappings for admin binding (e.g., isAdmin, roles) and fail-safe behavior when SAML attribute is missing (deny changes and alert).
- Console UX: admin settings page additions, with descriptions, interstitial confirmation for blocking export, and a change history panel showing who changed what and when.
- Safety: a soft 'warn' mode for export_block_mode that logs and shows a client-facing warning but allows export; 'block' mode denies.
- Tests: unit, integration, and e2e tests covering permission checks, audit emission, and UI flows.

Non-goals: per-user allowlists, per-resource export controls, and retention policy changes for audit logs (separate ticket).

Design & implementation notes:
- Enforce server-side in the API gateway and service layer to prevent bypass via SDKs. Middle-tier and control plane must check both org-level toggles and RBAC permissions.
- Use the existing audit schema extension (audit.v2) and include fields: org_id, actor_id, actor_email, action, target_type, target_id, ip_address, client, prior_value, new_value, reason, request_id.
- For Dedicated/Private customers with on-prem control plane, provide a feature flag to require 2-person approval before applying 'block' export.
- Provide an admin-only API endpoint to preview impacted resources (e.g., list of shared links that would be disabled) before applying the change. This preview must be rate-limited and available only to org admins.

Acceptance criteria:
- Org admin can toggle IP allowlist, disable public sharing, and set export_block_mode via Console and API.
- All enforcement actions are logged and visible in the Console's change history.
- SSO/SAML-admin-mapped accounts can change toggles; non-admins are denied and receive 403.
- Export in 'warn' mode returns success but includes a warning banner and emits a 'export_attempt_warned' audit event; in 'block' mode returns 403 and emits 'export_blocked' event.
- IP allowlist denies non-allowed IPs for console and API logins and emits audit events with the denied IP.

Rollout plan:
Phase 1 (canary tenants): server enforcement + audit events + API (no Console UI). Enable for small set of pilot tenants.
Phase 2: Console UI + preview endpoint + 'warn' mode enabled for more tenants. Collect metrics.
Phase 3: Default 'block' available with approval workflow for Dedicated/Private.

Monitoring & metrics:
- Metric: toggle_changes_by_org (counter)
- Metric: blocked_exports_count (counter)
- Metric: allowlist_denies_per_minute (count)
- Dashboard: show top orgs with most blocked events and heatmap of IP deny spikes.

Security considerations:
- Changes to toggles must be logged with strong integrity guarantees (signed events or append-only storage).
- Avoid exposing sensitive metadata in audit events (truncate payloads; if export fails, do not include file contents).
- Consider retention policy for audit logs (separate follow-up).

Related artifacts: design doc (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/admin-guardrails, mockups: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/mockups/admin-guardrails-v1.png, initial PR for audit schema: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
